title: A goal research worker's alias rows reach the kb, though a research item's touches may never name _tools/aliases.csv
goal: The kb-research skill, run as a sprint's goal research worker (a research item whose touches lie inside one kb root, never _tools/), says in step 4 that the alias rows for a new topic's other names go to a follow-up backlog item the worker files with the rows and a touch of _tools/aliases.csv, so they land (SP-qjn563cf: ST-pnr4zyni wrote 48 alias rows for 14 new topics, found _tools/aliases.csv outside its touches, restored it and left the rows in scratch, which ST-zrysu6ri carries)

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-research/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split('## 4. Write',1)[1].split('## 5. Check',1)[0];ok=any('aliases.csv' in l and 'follow-up' in l for l in t.splitlines());print('research step 4 sends alias rows to a follow-up item:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Where do a goal research worker's alias rows go so they land, since its touches lie inside one kb root and never name _tools/aliases.csv? kbfacts.aliases reads _tools/aliases.csv plus each root's own _retrieval/aliases.csv, but ql_apply and the public-root convention keep the public root's product names in _tools/aliases.csv only.

notes:
Gate g1 answered follow-up item (recommended): kbfacts.aliases reads _tools/aliases.csv plus each root's own _retrieval/aliases.csv, but ql_apply and the public root's convention keep product names in _tools/aliases.csv only, and a content lane carries _tools/aliases.csv (kblane _FILES), so a follow-up item with that touch is the smallest route and adds no second place for product names.
Premise: kb-research SKILL.md step 4 holds no line naming 'aliases.csv' with 'follow-up' (its retrieval-data bullet names _tools/aliases.csv rows with no route for a worker whose touches exclude it). Run at planning with precheck: the check exits 1 (False).
Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 10 of 15, "Research and content workers: sweep contradicted lines, check DER facts, keep anchors and eval rows in scope"): a lookup returns a wrong or missing fact until it is fixed, which the held-out answer-rate fitness test of EP-gzr4mmkm reads.
